description: This file defines API routes for managing blog posts, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and versioning posts within a FastAPI application. It relies on SQLAlchemy ORM models and schemas to handle data serialization and validation.

methods.name: ensure_owner(post: Post, user: User)
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the owner of the post or an admin; raises HTTP 403 if unauthorized.

methods.name: list_posts(db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists posts owned by the current user, with admins able to see all posts.

methods.name: create_post(post_in: PostCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new post and its initial version, returning the created post.

methods.name: get_post(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific post by ID after verifying ownership.

methods.name: update_post(post_id: int, post_in: PostUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates a post’s content and/or title/topic, increments version, and records the new version.

methods.name: delete_post(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a post and its versions.

methods.name: list_versions(post_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all versions of a specified post.

methods.name: get_version(post_id: int, version_number: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific version of a post.
